// Package fixture holds the store.
package fixture

type Store struct{}

// NewStore opens the database at path, creating it if missing.
func NewStore(path string) *Store { return &Store{} }

// Close flushes pending writes before releasing the file lock.
func (s *Store) Close() error { return nil }

// Limit is how many sessions may start per minute; more are queued.
const Limit = 3

// Kind values match the wire format, so never reorder them.
type Kind int

// ID returns the tmux window id, such as @3.
func ID() string { return "" }

// Store section: the lock order is store, then session.
var order = 1
